issues.quote: How I used to long for them at times!
They wove their existence into mine in a fantastic net
roaring torrents of human life that raced toward me like wild horses
I was irritated by the uncertainty trembling in me
Let cleanliness and peace come into the house.
And when that beautiful brother of death came and took me to himself

strengths.quote: Throw out the litterers along with the litter.
and the iron hand clack its bones in vain
like splinters and straw on spring floodwaters
clickety-clack-clack... our division was stationed there then... clickety-clack-clack
My heart can hold no more. It is full to the brim.
